about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque Si4 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque Si4 was the petrol option in the original L538-generation Range Rover Evoque range, produced from 2011 to 2016. It uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine — a four-cylinder unit shared across several Ford and Land Rover models of that era. The Si4 was discontinued when the Evoque range transitioned to Ingenium petrol engines (P200, P250) from 2016 onwards. The Si4 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Evoque Si4 Engine Compatibility The Evoque Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre engine. The Evoque Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine. It was fitted to the L538-generation Evoque from 2011 to 2016. How much does a Range Rover Evoque Si4 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Evoque Si4? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild Ford EcoBoost Evoque Si4 engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard on every EcoBoost rebuild. Do you supply used Evoque Si4 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Evoque Si4 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an Evoque Si4 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Evoque Si4 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque Si4 from 2023 to present. The Ford EcoBoost features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost rebuild.
